condition: meter and use location annual allocation
action: Apply 2523 kWh discounted cap then higher price to excess
notes: Annual window is Aug 1-Jul 31 and is prorated.

condition: date between October 15 and April 15 inclusive
notes: Outside season use A1 higher rate.

condition: heat pump or renewable heat device and seasonal factor >=3.4 and dedicated measured circuit
action: Allow H tariff only for directly serving eligible loads
notes: Separate permanently connected circuit; not plug-in.

condition: battery charging or export is not explicitly proven
action: Do not assign H tariff; retain Q

condition: H_TARIFF_BATTERY_CHARGE_ALLOWED requires current explicit legal and metering evidence for the actual topology
action: Do not price or dispatch battery charge on H; retain Q when evidence is absent
notes: Snapshot applicability 2026-08-24. H-only dedicated circuit is limited by source to eligible heat-pump/direct auxiliary loads; normal/A1-only, H-side battery and hybrid/common-bus configurations are not interchangeable.

condition: H_TARIFF_BATTERY_DISCHARGE_ALLOWED requires current explicit legal and metering evidence for discharge into or through H
action: Do not let physical battery discharge create H-tariff or cross-meter eligibility; retain Q
notes: Snapshot applicability 2026-08-24. Charge and discharge are separate gates; physical capability is not a legal status.

condition: H_TARIFF_EXPORT_ALLOWED requires explicit H/DSO/HMKE evidence for the actual POD and wiring
action: Do not permit H-side or H-charged-battery export; retain Q
notes: Snapshot applicability 2026-08-24. Export is a distinct gate from charge and discharge; HMKE portal evidence is procedural and not an H-battery authorization.

condition: separate permanently connected non-plugged H circuit serving eligible heat-pump/renewable-heat equipment and direct auxiliaries
action: Apply H only to the evidenced eligible load scope
notes: Current legal/customer wording proves this boundary; it does not classify an energy storage device.

condition: normal/A1 household circuit is not the H dedicated circuit
action: Do not transfer H eligibility to normal/A1 battery flows
notes: Boundary distinction only; no separate battery tariff permission is inferred.

condition: battery connected only on normal/A1 side
action: Route battery to normal/A1 contract inputs; do not label it H
notes: Model topology is distinct from H-side wiring; tariff/legal status of the battery remains outside this evidence.

condition: battery physically connected to H-side circuit
action: Block H battery charge/discharge assignment until explicit current authority is supplied
notes: No explicit source authorization; fail closed.

condition: hybrid inverter or common AC bus can couple H and normal/A1 paths
action: Block tariff assignment and cross-meter dispatch until wiring and authority are explicit
notes: Physical possibility does not establish contractual permission.

action: Require POD-specific DSO/MGT evidence; do not infer H export permission
notes: MEKH portal describes a POD/DSO process, not a blanket H-tariff export rule.

action: Do not infer B/H use on the same connection
notes: PV/HMKE restriction is separate from battery economics.

condition: household product and legal measurement not evidenced
action: Keep dynamic price Q and do not use HUPX wholesale as retail
notes: Wholesale spot is not a household tariff.
